weighting.scenarios: equal source plus, for each of four sources, weight 1.2 and weight 0.8 with all other weights 1.0; normalized weighted mean

p2_rule.definition_timing: before examining win/loss for repair choice; first-event contract only
requirements: unique replacement and priority before execution
schedule consistency or explicit recovery after position changes

development_confirmation.completion_gate: the unweakened E4 conditions in the Japanese preregistration document

license_cap: P1 remains research-only and cannot yield a numeric production agent while transitive route-data provenance/license is unverified
stop_rule: Any discovery-gate failure prevents new Development seeds; no threshold, selector, source, or repair search is permitted
